entities.summary: Melvin Luther Watt is an American politician who served as director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency from 2014 to 2019. He was appointed by President Barack Obama. He is a former United States representative for North Carolina's 12th congressional district, from 1993 to 2014. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Mel Watt was a legal figures from Steele Creek (b. 1945-08-26, Steele Creek). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
